children.characters: A text input component for forms and user data entry with built-in styling and accessibility features.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use Field, FieldLabel, and FieldDescription to create an input with a label and description.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use FieldGroup to show multiple Field blocks and to build forms.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use the disabled prop to disable the input. To style the disabled state, add the data-disabled attribute to the Field component.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use the aria-invalid prop to mark the input as invalid. To style the invalid state, add the data-invalid attribute to the Field component.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use the type="file" prop to create a file input.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use Field with orientation="horizontal" to create an inline input. Pair with Button to create a search input with a button.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use a grid layout to place multiple inputs side by side.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use the required attribute to indicate required inputs.

children.name: Description
children.characters: Use Badge in the label to highlight a recommended field.
